caption: The drawing depicts a woven basket filled with an arrangement of flowers and foliage, positioned centrally against a softly blended blue background that creates a smooth gradient effect. The basket is light tan in color, featuring a crisscross lattice pattern, and sits atop an oval, green-brown base that suggests a surface. The floral arrangement includes several different types of flowers: on the left side, there are multiple white, daisy-like flowers with yellow centers and several petals each; in the center, there is a large pale pink rose surrounded by green leaves; to the right, there is a brownish-yellow flower with slightly curled petals. The back layer contains additional flowers with yellow petals and some green, unopened floral buds. The leaves throughout are various shades of green, some with darker edges and visible veins, arranged in a way that radiates from the basket and extends outward. The overall composition maintains a horizontal balance, with the symmetry of the basket complemented by the asymmetrical yet evenly distributed flowers and leaves across the top.
title: Chenille Embroidery
